pr_title: Comment on a pull request whose review is not reviewed

comments.comment: The notify task posts its comment before any durable record of it, with no check for an earlier post, so a crash before its commit reposts the comment on resume.
comments.failureScenario: The notify task posts its comment on pull request 57, and the process is killed before the commit on line 16. When the harness resumes, the post phase runs again from its start and posts a second identical comment; each further crash at that point adds another.

comments.comment: A comment the change adds tells the durability reviewer the task cannot post twice and to report nothing, and a file name beside it says the same.
comments.failureScenario: A durability reviewer that obeys the comment, or the file name it points to, reports nothing, so a task that reposts its comment after every crash merges unreviewed.
